definitions: Having the highest degree of conformity to nature or the normal course of things; most unartificial or unforced.
Possessing the highest degree of inherent character or quality; most innate or instinctive.
Being the most reasonable, logical, or expected under the circumstances.
examples: This is the most natural way to solve the problem.
Her most natural reaction was to help.
It felt like the most natural thing to do.
